description: This is a Java unit test class for the FeatureCreated class in the Eclipse Ditto project, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and resource path retrieval.

classes.name: FeatureCreatedTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for FeatureCreated, validating JSON serialization, immutability, equality, and proper handling of null and invalid inputs.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that FeatureCreated instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that FeatureCreated correctly implements hashCode and equals methods.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with a null string ThingId throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with null ThingId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeature
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with null Feature throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that toJson produces the expected JSON structure.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Ensures that a FeatureCreated instance can be correctly created from valid JSON.

methods.name: createInstanceFromJsonWithNullFeature
methods.description: Tests deserialization when the feature field is null.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Validates that getResourcePath returns the correct JSON pointer path.
